# Vamos UI — block catalog

106 blocks — whole screens to start from. Install with `npx vamos-ui add <name>` (files land in `blocksDir/<name>/`, required components are installed too). Preview any block at https://ui.vamos.ist/view/<name>.

Pick the block whose screen is closest, then adapt the content to the real domain; do not compose a screen from scratch when a block fits. Tags: `cms`, `crm`, `hr`, `ops`, `site`, `any`.
